changes: A new, simpler look: one word and an icon for every menu item and button, a menu down the left on a laptop and along the bottom on a phone, and one green button that always shows your next step.

Help that stays out of the way: a one-minute walkthrough the first time you open QuickCheck, and one short tip on each page with a link to the full guide. Press Got it and that tip is gone; Settings → Help turns tips off, brings them back, or plays the walkthrough again.
Every page works the same way: buttons say "Saving…" and can't send twice, a problem is shown right at the box that needs fixing, and QuickCheck asks before deleting anything.
Easier on a phone: bigger buttons and tap areas, tables that scroll sideways instead of squeezing, and no page that slides left and right.

Better printouts: the learner, progress and intervention reports print on A4 with no app menu or web address on the paper, page numbers at the bottom, and signature lines that never end up alone on the last page.
Downloads show they are working: "Making PDF…" appears until the file is saved.
Fixed: on the Answer key, pressing an arrow key after typing answers could change item 1. The arrow keys now only move between the letters of the item you are on.
Fixed: after an update, a browser could keep showing parts of the old look.
Kinder to the eyes: clearer text colours throughout, and no movement for teachers who turned animations off in Windows.

Edit existing classes and learner lists: rename a class, correct a learner's name, add learners or remove them in QuickCheck scorebooks and supported DepEd Excel records. Saved papers, scores and printed-sheet history stay attached to the right learner.
Fixed laptop imports of JPEG photos saved with the .jfif filename. JPG, PNG, JFIF, scanned PDF and ZIP batches now use the same checking flow.
Fixed named sheets printed before a class was renamed: QuickCheck now remembers the old printed class code and still identifies the learner, while sheets from another class remain blocked.
